analysis.reason: The test expected HTTP 200 for product ID 1 but the API returned 404 with message 'Requested item not found'. The results show the resource was not found, but there is no evidence whether this is due to missing test data/environment setup, an application defect (resource unexpectedly deleted or not created), or an incorrect test expectation. No API contract or environment logs were provided to narrow the cause.
analysis.recommendedAction: 1) Verify that product ID 1 is present in the environment used for this test (check test data seeding and DB). 2) Confirm the API contract/documentation indicates product 1 should exist and that 200 is the correct expected status. 3) Re-run the request manually (or via curl/Postman) to reproduce and capture full response headers and body. 4) If resource should exist, check application logs and database for errors creating/serving the product to determine if this is an application defect. 5) If resource should not exist, update the test expectation or test data accordingly.
